title: passageway connector protocol v1
description: The JSON objects of the connector protocol, one per line. Validate with the definition for the mode: check -> check, list -> listRecord, fetch -> fetchRequest on stdin and item on stdout, changed -> item. Unknown fields are allowed and ignored, so the protocol can grow.

count.description: The number of items `list` would print.

protocol.description: Optional. The protocol version the connector speaks.

listRecord.description: A line of `list`: one per existing item.

version.description: Any string that changes when the content changes.

fetchRequest.description: A line of stdin for `fetch`: the id of an item to return.

item.description: A line of `fetch` or `changed`: one item with its sections.
